# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c18 P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane's appearance is described as plain in comparison to more showy peers, yet neat and sensible.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047)_

## Personality

Jane is practical, calm, and matter-of-fact, lacking high-flown artistic aspirations or deep imaginative tendencies. She approaches her duties with a straightforward attitude, prioritizing discipline and clear rules in the classroom. Despite her sensible disposition, she enjoys reading dramatic, emotional books and values closeness with her childhood friends.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P17](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0017), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P6](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0006), [v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014)_

## Traits

- Practical  <sub>[v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008)</sub>
- Matter-of-fact  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>
- Strict disciplinarian  <sub>[v2 c4 P6](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0006), [v2 c4 P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching and maintaining classroom order  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>

## Goals

- Earn her teaching salary fairly and please the school trustees  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>
- Get her name on the School Inspector's roll of honor  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>

## History

Jane grows up in Avonlea as a schoolmate and companion to Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Ruby Gillis. During her youth, she participates in various childhood pastimes, such as spending midsummer afternoons by the pond and joining in the dramatization of Tennyson's poem of Elaine. As she completes her studies, she earns her qualification to teach school. Upon entering the teaching profession, she accepts a position to teach at Newbridge, taking a pragmatic stance on discipline that includes a willingness to use corporal punishment if necessary.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c28 P9](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0009), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P6](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0006)_

## Quotes

> I think diamonds would comfort a person for a good deal.  <sub>[v1 c33 P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047)</sub>
